audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem BanachMazur.exists_compatiblePlay.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (σ : BanachMazur.FirstStrategy X) :
  Exists fun a => BanachMazur.Follows X σ a
audit_declarations.name: BanachMazur.exists_compatiblePlay

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem BanachMazur.follows_intersection_eq.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (σ : BanachMazur.FirstStrategy X)
  (a : Nat → BanachMazur.OpenMove X) (ha : BanachMazur.Follows X σ a) :
  Eq (Set.iInter fun n => Subtype.val (BanachMazur.FirstStrategy.move σ (BanachMazur.history X a n)))
    (Set.iInter fun n => Subtype.val (a n))
audit_declarations.name: BanachMazur.follows_intersection_eq

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem BanachMazur.exists_commonPoint_play.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [BaireSpace X]
  (σ : BanachMazur.FirstStrategy X) :
  Exists fun a => And (BanachMazur.Follows X σ a) (Set.Nonempty (Set.iInter fun n => Subtype.val (a n)))
audit_declarations.name: BanachMazur.exists_commonPoint_play

theorem BanachMazur.not_firstWins_of_baireSpace.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [BaireSpace X]

theorem BanachMazur.exists_firstWins_of_not_baireSpace.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (hX : Not (BaireSpace X)) :
  Exists fun σ => BanachMazur.FirstWins X σ

audit_declarations.declaration:
theorem BanachMazur.baireSpace_iff_no_firstWins.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] :
  Iff (BaireSpace X) (∀ (σ : BanachMazur.FirstStrategy X), Not (BanachMazur.FirstWins X σ))
audit_declarations.name: BanachMazur.baireSpace_iff_no_firstWins

theorem BanachMazur.isEmpty_firstStrategy.{u} {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [IsEmpty X] :
